title: Jayson Tatum Put on Notice as Jaylen Brown's Role With Boston Celtics Sparks Leadership Debate - NewsBreak
text:
By Shabiha Akter ,
1 hours ago
Jayson Tatum (Image Credits: Imagn) There was considerable concern around the league when the Boston Celtics began the season without Jayson Tatum, especially regarding how the team would perform under Jaylen Brown’s leadership. The Celtics stumbled out of the gate with a 0-3 record. However, Brown quickly showed a turnaround in his leadership responsibility.
Despite the absence of Tatum, the Celtics have managed to climb to the No. 2 seed in the Eastern Conference. Meanwhile, speculation continues to grow about Tatum potentially returning from his Achilles injury this season.
Although his comeback is not yet confirmed, one analyst recently offered a strong take on how the dynamic could change once the Celtics star returns to the court. On the Run It Back podcast, Chris Mannix stated that Tatum might have to adjust to the current structure of the team under Brown’s leadership.
“I think Tatum knows, coming back, he’s stepping onto Jaylen Brown’s team. Brown is a top-5, top-6 MVP candidate this year. He has put this team on his back offensively, and Tatum’s going to have to find a way to fit into that. I think there will be an adjustment. But I ultimately think he’s going to be fine. He’s Jayson Tatum ,” Mannix said.
Tatum has been making strong progress throughout his rehabilitation process. Last month, the 28-year-old NBA champion participated in practice sessions with the Maine Celtics , the franchise’s G League affiliate. Since then, he has taken another major step forward by returning to five-on-five scrimmages after spending 39 weeks recovering.
Bill Simmons recently floated the possibility that Tatum could return in their upcoming game against the Dallas Mavericks . However, neither Tatum nor the Celtics organization has provided a definitive timeline regarding his return.
Fans Blast Analyst’s Controversial Claim Towards Jayson Tatum Jayson Tatum (Image Credits: Imagn) Mannix’s comments quickly sparked reactions across social media. Many fans strongly disagreed with the suggestion that the Celtics had become Brown’s team while Tatum was sidelined, apart from only one fan.
“ But it’s not his team. Never was and never will be ,” one fan wrote.
“Such a stupid lazy argument ,’ one comment read.
“Guy literally just says s*** to say s*** ,” an angry fan commented.
